title: UX Recovery Flow Compiler
description: Validates recovery flow specs: all failure states have declared recovery actions, retry counts are bounded, critical failures have escape hatches, offline failures have fallbacks, error messages are specific, and backoff is declared for multi-retry recoveries. Produces recovery-flow-artifact.json.

pipeline.title: Parse Intent
pipeline.description: Extract recovery-flow-spec.json from feature brief and error taxonomy

pipeline.title: Structure
pipeline.description: Validate spec shape and failure structure

pipeline.title: Coverage
pipeline.description: Validate that all failures have recovery actions, escape hatches, and offline fallbacks

pipeline.title: Policy
pipeline.description: Validate retry limits, backoff strategies, and error message quality

gates.title: Spec Valid
gates.description: recovery-flow-spec.json exists with failures array, each failure has id, trigger, recovery

gates.title: All Failures Covered
gates.description: Every failure has a recovery object with at least one of: retry, redirect, fallback, contactSupport

gates.title: Escape Hatch
gates.description: Critical and fatal failures declare an escapeHatch action

gates.title: Offline Fallback
gates.description: Failures triggered by offline/network conditions declare a fallback

gates.title: Retry Limits
gates.description: All retry recoveries have maxRetries between 1 and 10; retry:true without maxRetries is forbidden

gates.title: Error Message Quality
gates.description: All failures declare a specific userMessage — generic placeholders are violations

gates.title: Recovery Flow Contract
gates.description: Version, unique failure ids, at least one failure declared

contracts.description: Structural requirements for all compiled recovery flow specs

error_codes.URF001: recovery-flow-spec.json missing or invalid — failures array with id, trigger, recovery required
error_codes.URF002: Failure has empty or actionless recovery object
error_codes.URF003: Retry limit violation — maxRetries out of range 1–10 or retry:true without maxRetries
error_codes.URF006: Failure missing userMessage or using generic placeholder text
error_codes.URF007: Multi-retry recovery missing backoff strategy declaration
error_codes.URF008: Recovery flow contract violation — version, unique ids, or failure count missing
